grades: Current sophomores and juniors (the page also says rising juniors and seniors)
name: Georgia DNR Career Academy
org: Georgia Department of Natural Resources (with Georgia 4-H)
what_you_do: Spend a week in small groups with DNR staff. Try electrofishing, planned burns, boating and gun safety, trail building and saltwater fish counts. Learn about jobs in nature care.
who_can_apply: Georgia residents who are current sophomores or juniors. The page does not list an age limit.
pay_detail: $100, which covers all meals and lodging. The page does not mention scholarships.
deadline_text: Application opens Oct 14, 2026 and closes Nov 16, 2026. Selected students interview online in early December. Camp is July 18 to 24, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Upload a permission form from a guardian. Add one letter from an adult who is not family.
notes: Camp sites are Charlie Elliott Wildlife Center in Mansfield and Camp Jekyll on Jekyll Island. Students can earn college credit for Intro to Wildlife Management (FWMT 1000) at no cost. Check YES on the application.
